Subject: POC: Prompt set & eval dataset — next steps and success criteria

Hi Alicia / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the clear context on the search/assist flows and the pilot goals. Wanted to capture next steps from our side and confirm what ACME can share for the POC evaluation: 

1) Success criteria (what "good" looks like) — you mentioned improved answer relevance and faster agent resolution. Can you confirm numeric targets (e.g., +X% relevance, <Ys median latency) or qualitative acceptance criteria?

2) Prompt & eval dataset — for model eval we need: a) ~200 representative prompts (mix of short/long/edge cases) b) ~300 anonymized log examples (user question + expected response/label) c) any rule-based post-processing or business logic that the model must respect. CSV or JSONL is fine; see template in the Drive link below.

3) Ownership & timeline — who will own collecting and redacting the logs on ACME side, and target date to hand off the dataset so we can start the POC? We recommend a kickoff ingest 3 business days before the POC start for QA/format checks.

4) POC scope & timeline — proposed 2-week evaluation after data ingest; we’ll run 2 model variants and provide a short report + recommended config.

Deliverables from Redwood:
- Eval harness + baseline run results
- Prompt-response snapshots and quality metrics
- Short write-up with recommended model/config and cost estimate

I've uploaded a sample template and success criteria doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc-assets (sample files: acme_prompt_samples.csv, acme_poc_success_criteria.docx). Please let us know if ACME has any additional compliance/redaction requirements (e.g., specific PII policies) — we can route to our security team.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- ACME: confirm success criteria + owner for dataset (target by Tue 2026-03-23)
- ACME: upload sample prompts + logs (ideally by Thu 2026-03-25)
- Redwood: confirm POC start date once we have the dataset (we can start validation within 48 hours of receipt)

Thanks — I’m looping in Aditya and Dev on technical questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Alicia — thanks for the quick confirmation and for the targets. A couple of clarifications to make the ingest smooth:

- File format: prefer CSV for prompts and JSONL for labeled logs; if CSV is easier we’ll accept that but need a column for "expected_label" or "gold_response". Use the sample file in the Drive for column names.
- Redaction: ACME should replace any PII with placeholders (e.g., <NAME>, <EMAIL>) and keep a mapping doc internally. We don’t need actual identifiers. If there are policy constraints beyond that, please flag them.
- Labels: for NDCG we’ll need a relevance label per prompt (0/1/2) or a ranked list; if you can include a small judge-file we’ll map to our metrics.

If Tom can drop the first batch by Wed 03/24 we’ll validate format and queue the baseline run on Thu. Aditya / Dev — feel free to jump in if I missed any technical requirements.

Marissa
